text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
...Mmm.
Don't tell me I won't catch a single fish.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Hmm, maybe I'll head a little further upstream.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
All right, this time I'm definitely reeling one in.
Just you wait, little fishy~

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Ah, it just ate the bait and ran...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, some days are just like that.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Waiting leisurely without rushing
is the secret to reeling in a big catch.

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Well, fishing's just a hobby of mine anyway...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Fish can be fickle, so it's not unusual even if we don't catch anything at all...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
—N-No, at least one fish!
I can't quit until I catch at least one...!

And so, Seiun Sky
ended up slacking off on her training...
